videos.script: An access key works until somebody deletes it. That is the whole problem this lesson is about. {{two}} AWS signs requests with two kinds of credential. A user's key, which never expires. And a role's session, which stops on its own. {{akia}} You will make one of each, and read the difference in the ids. {{leak}} Then a key leaks. caio put his in a file beside the code. A one-line search finds it, and so would anybody's scanner. {{quarantine}} AWS can put a brake on a leaked key. You will apply that brake yourself, and see what it stops and what it lets through. {{rotate}} Then the fix: rotation, in an order that never leaves the application without a working key. {{secret}} And finally, a place for the database password that is not a file at all. {{app}} The application asks for it by name, with its own identity, when it starts. {{end}}
